limitations: Stage tips 1070, 1140, and 1143 are extraction blanks, absent from the paper's fossil-only Extended Data Table 1. Their method assignments follow the paired sequential tip numbers and raw run groups and are explicitly inferred.
All blank rows use nominal biological replicate 1 to satisfy the validator; this is a run-group index, not a biological fossil replicate.
Search settings vary between PEAKS and MaxQuant; no single mass tolerance or modification list is imposed on all runs.
